name: frontier-apis
_comment: Frontier APIs. Keys are read from the environment variables named in api_key_env and are never written to results. Prices come from config/pricing.json (verify the model identifiers against each provider before running). Hugging Face Inference Providers use kind openai_compatible with base_url https://router.huggingface.co/v1 — record the inference provider, because an open model has no universal token price.
